INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA
  Website: www.cityofinglewood.org

  NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF
  The CIVIL SERVICE BOARD OF REVIEW
  (Government Code Section 54956)

NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Board Members that a Hearing of the Civil Service Board
of Review will be held on Tuesday, February 15 and Wednesday, February 16, 2011 commencing
at 5:30 P.M. (room to be announced), One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California
(Government Code Section 54956)
  MEMBERS

Mayor Appointee  District 3
Mr. Gene Eldridge  Mr. Roberto Munoz
District 1  District 4
Mr. Twain Wilson  Ms. Chibuzo Walton
District 2
Mr. Jim Jordan

Said special meeting shall include the following:

  AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE BOARD OF REVIEW
Call to Order

Roll Call

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS ONLY

Persons wishing to address the Civil Service Board of Review on closed session items may do so at
this time.

  CS-1 Closed session—Confidential – Attorney/Client Privileged; Personnel Exemption,
  Government Code Section 54957(b)(1); Peace Officer Discipline/Suspension/Termination
  (confidential under Penal Code 832.7 and Copley Press v. Superior Court, 39 Cal. 4th 1272
  (2006).

DISCUSSION

ACTION ITEMS

COMMISSION ADVISOR REPORTS

STAFF REMARKS

BOARD MEMBERS REMARKS

ADJOURNMENT
  In the event that today's meeting of the Civil Service Board of Review is not held, or is
  concluded prior to a another agenda item being considered, the agenda item will automatically
  be continued to the next regularly scheduled Civil Service Board of Review meeting.
